mostWorthwhile.text: Cooling the gas envelope was most worthwhile: it explained why losing energy allows a growing core to accumulate more gas.

leastWorthwhile.text: The late-core sequence was briefly confusing: I tried the dispersing disk before gathering its solid material.

surprise.text: I learned that an envelope must cool and contract to allow more gas to join, rather than simply collecting gas under gravity.

arbitrary.text: Using open space for radiative cooling was initially a guess, though the result explained its purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the developing worlds relate to the eventual Earth, especially if the story keeps explaining the physical processes behind the combinations.
